description: First-load budget for the browser package (docs/hosting.md, 'Browser budget'). test/budget.mjs measures the published page and fails when a measurement exceeds its entry in 'enforced'.

target.decision: docs/ROADMAP.md, 2026-10-28: first load under 5 s on a mid-range phone over slow 4G
target.network: Slow 4G as Lighthouse and Chrome DevTools define it: 1.6 Mbit/s down, 150 ms round trip
target.roundTripsReason: DNS, TCP and TLS, then the page's chain of dependent requests: index.html, playground.js, moonsharp.js, dotnet.js, the runtime scripts, then the assemblies and dotnet.native.wasm in parallel
target.cpuSlowdownReason: Lighthouse's CPU multiplier for a mid-tier phone against the desktop that runs the test
target.transfer: brotli: dotnet publish writes a .br file next to every published file, and a production server sends it
target.derivedBudget: with a 500 ms desktop start (2 s on the phone) and 1.35 s of round trips, 1.65 s of transfer is left: 346,000 brotli bytes

enforced.reason: The target is out of reach for .NET WebAssembly under these assumptions: dotnet.native.wasm alone is 976 KB brotli, 4.7 s at 1.6 Mbit/s. Until the owner chooses another network assumption or another runtime, CI holds the measured state of 2026-10-28 (1,774,807 bytes; desktop start 0.67-1.11 s, median of 5, on a shared machine at load average 6-8) with a margin for noisy CI runners, so the download and the start cannot grow unnoticed.
